baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَلِيلٌ qualifies a partitive group مِنَ ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Numerical scarcity combines with posteriority to select a small subset from those after the first.

activation_trace.role: Literal scarcity supplies the small quantity assigned to the cohort.
Being after the first supplies the cohort's relative temporal or sequential identity.

changed_reading.before: Some unspecified relation to later people is asserted.
changed_reading.after: Only a small subset belongs to the post-first cohort.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus juxtaposes scarcity with a word that can mark delay or the rear of a sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase can profile a small delayed tail or end-position, not only label a historical population.

activation_trace.role: Scarcity makes the tail small.
Delay to a later time turns the group label into a late-arrival process.
The rear or back supplies a sequential edge where the small remainder sits.

changed_reading.before: The later ones are only a chronological block.
changed_reading.after: They may also be the small delayed tail at the back edge of a sequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: An unavoidable severe event lowers and raises, destabilizes the ground, and disperses matter; against that process, the few later ones read as a remainder produced by radical sorting rather than a static census.

activation_trace.role: Scarcity names the small result left by the proposed sorting process.
What is delayed until later supplies the process's terminal cohort.
The severe descending event initiates the mechanism that can alter group proportions.
Lowering after height supplies one direction of the sorting reversal.
Elevation of rank supplies the opposite direction and prevents equating fewness with low status.
Violent agitation removes stable prior arrangement.
Fine dispersed dust supplies the material image of a mass reduced and redistributed.
Scattering supplies the final dispersive step before human grouping.

structural_cues: 56:1-6 progresses from certainty through status inversion to shaken terrain and dispersed dust.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disruption, inversion, and dispersal; I infer a winnowing arrow from that sequence to the small later cohort. The sequence may instead stage the event without causing the cohort ratio.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a fixed demographic scarcity.
changed_reading.after: The scarcity can be heard as the terminal remainder of an overturning and dispersive sorting, with quantity and rank explicitly decoupled.

context_deltas.mechanism: A three-class taxonomy narrows to the repeated foremost and the brought-near, then the adjacent former/later pair distributes that class asymmetrically across sequence-time.

activation_trace.role: Scarcity supplies the smaller side of the paired class distribution.
Posteriority supplies the second temporal side of the distribution.
A kind or class supplies the taxonomic frame rather than a census of humanity as a whole.
The number three fixes the larger classification within which one class is selected.
Repeated precedence identifies the selected class by advance.
The elite intimates of a ruler supply the selected class's brought-near status.
A gathered company supplies the numerous counterpart to the focus verse's few.
Beginning and precedence establish the first side opposed by the focus's later side.
The split-root image of succession sharpens the ordered transition from former to later.

structural_cues: The repeated nominal ٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ is resolved by أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ before the parallel count lines in 56:13-14.
56:13 and 56:14 share the construction quantity + مِنَ + temporal cohort.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies class labels and an adjacent syntactic pair; I infer that the ellipsis carries the foremost/brought-near class into both count lines. A live alternative is that the pair counts a broader blessed population.

changed_reading.before: Only a few later people exist or qualify in an unrestricted sense.
changed_reading.after: Later representation is sparse specifically within the foremost, brought-near class, relative to its gathered former cohort.

context_deltas.mechanism: Elevation, elite nearness, good condition, active choosing, pearl imagery, and protective concealment reverse the deficit pole of scarcity: the cohort is few in number but concentrated in distinction.

activation_trace.role: Scarcity and diminishment supply the apparent deficit that the value sequence revises.
Elevation of rank makes numerical smallness compatible with high standing.
Elite nearness gives the small cohort a selective social value.
Good condition and blessing negate a deprivation reading of fewness.
Choosing the beneficial supplies a selection mechanism rather than mere numerical loss.
The pearl supplies concentrated value as the material analogue for a small distinguished set.
Protective concealment makes smallness read as guarded selectivity.

structural_cues: The focus cohort is framed before and after by elevation, nearness, bliss, choosing, and a protected-pearl simile.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies high-status and high-value descriptions; I infer that they evaluate the numbered cohort and reverse scarcity-as-deficiency. They may describe only the cohort's setting, not why its number is small.

changed_reading.before: Fewness implies weakness, deprivation, or insignificance.
changed_reading.after: Fewness marks a concentrated, selected distinction whose low number does not lower its rank or condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's delay branch is followed by recompense tied to intentional work and by negated تأثيم, whose branch includes delay from good; chronological laterness is thereby separated from culpable tardiness.

activation_trace.role: Delay to a later time supplies the potentially ambiguous lateness that the later cues qualify.
Corresponding recompense supplies an evaluative criterion distinct from chronology.
Intentional action supplies what the stated recompense answers to.
Delay from good is present as a branch image but negated in the source, blocking its equation with simple laterness.

structural_cues: 56:24 states recompense بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ, and 56:25 grammatically negates تَأْثِيمًا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deed-linked recompense and negated culpable delay; I infer a contrast between two kinds of lateness. The roots may remain locally separate with no intended interaction.

changed_reading.before: Being among the later ones suggests belatedness and therefore lesser moral standing.
changed_reading.after: Chronological lateness is not itself culpable delay from good; the nearby evaluative axis is action and recompense.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing acoustic scene filters out speech that does not count, then leaves one peace-utterance doubled; the packet's split ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping gives قِيلًا a scarcity echo, extending fewness from population to verbal repertoire.

activation_trace.role: Numerical scarcity supplies the focus image transferred experimentally to speech.
Auditory perception establishes speech as the domain in which selective reduction becomes perceptible.
What is discarded and not counted supplies the excluded verbal material.
Utterance by speech supplies the one surviving verbal act.
The non-dominant mapped scarcity branch makes قِيلًا echo the focus's قَلِيلٌ without asserting identity.
Safety and freedom from harm name the retained utterance, repeated after other speech is removed.

structural_cues: The لا ... ولا ... إلا restriction in 56:25-26 removes two speech classes and repeats سَلَامًا as the remainder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies filtered hearing, a split ق و ل mapping, and repeated peace; I infer a root-echo from population scarcity to speech economy, not an etymological identity. The baseline may remain purely numerical.

changed_reading.before: Fewness applies only to the number of later persons.
changed_reading.after: Fewness also resonates with an environment whose countable speech has been reduced to the repeated utterance of peace.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because قَلِيلٌ is not قُلَّة and the large-jar branch is form-distant; it remains anchored in the supplied ق ل ل inventory and is activated by the clustered cup, filled-cup, and spring images. Render it only as a material or paronomastic overlay, never as the lexical translation of قَلِيلٌ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root ق ل ل includes a large-vessel branch alongside scarcity.

activation_trace.role: The large jar supplies a paradoxical capacity image inside the word-root of fewness.
The handleless cup supplies the first explicit vessel that activates the distant jar image.
The cup defined by its contents sharpens the contrast between few containers and full capacity.
A flowing spring supplies continuing abundance against the focus's low headcount.

changed_reading.before: Fewness is an unqualified image of shortage.
changed_reading.after: As an associative overlay, low headcount stands inside a service ecology of large capacity and flowing abundance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This spatial reading is surprising because ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ normally marks a later cohort here and the rear/instability branches are distant; it remains anchored in both focus roots and is activated by woven, facing, circulating, and enduring arrangements. Render it as a topology analogy subordinate to the temporal reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus permits a small unstable rear edge through ق ل ل B006 and ء خ ر B003.

activation_trace.role: Movement and lack of fixed position make the small cohort spatially reconfigurable.
The rear or back supplies the initial marginal position.
Tight interweaving supplies incorporation into a coherent arrangement.
Mutual facing reorients a rear edge into reciprocal presence.
Circulation around the assembly replaces a fixed front-versus-back line.
Enduring stability contains the focus branch's instability.

changed_reading.before: The few later ones occupy the tail of a one-directional sequence.
changed_reading.after: As a spatial analogy, a small rear edge is woven into a stable face-to-face circulation with no fixed margin.

strongest_changes: The adjacent former/later pair restricts the count to the foremost, brought-near class and makes its temporal distribution asymmetric.
The opening inversion and dispersal turn a static count into a possible event-produced remainder while separating quantity from rank.
Recompense by action and negated culpable delay prevent chronological laterness from automatically implying moral tardiness.
The split ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping and restricted speech scene add an exploratory economy-of-speech echo.
summary.what_was_special: The direct syntactic pair gives the strongest revision; split-root mappings and the post-focus material, spatial, and acoustic sequences then preserve several contained readings that a purely demographic gloss would erase.
remaining_uncertainties: The count pair most likely continues the foremost/brought-near class, but a broader referential scope remains possible.
The opening disruption may frame rather than causally produce the cohort ratio.
The speech, vessel, and spatial readings are branch-licensed associative activations, not replacements for the ordinary scarcity-and-posteriority reading.
